boundary: spawn through child exit; stdout/stderr captured in memory and published after timer
source_policy: ONE new canonical checkout reused for all builds; PDM cleans and regenerates metadata each build
profile_policy: one separately profiled sdist-only build; not a clean timing sample
protection_policy: no ETW, exclusions, protection/global changes or CI

profile.scope: UNTIMED cProfile of canonical-mode stock-PDM sdist only
profile.strict_sdist_validation: passed all raw payloads and full modes

backend_bytecode_condition.observation_boundary: after complete timed matrix; no pre-trial bytecode census was taken
backend_bytecode_condition.policy: PYTHONDONTWRITEBYTECODE=1 in all trials; direct workers additionally set sys.dont_write_bytecode=True
backend_bytecode_condition.caveat: The flag prevents writes, not loading existing bytecode. This is not assumed to model prepared CI backend bytecode.
backend_bytecode_condition.compileall: not run; no mid-trial environment mutation or additional matrix

interpretation.prior_stall: Not reproduced: identical corrected writer is ~2.0s for both full and selective, versus historical selective ~7.13s.
interpretation.attribution: Same writer and shared checkout isolate extraction strategy locally; no Defender/MDE causal attribution or Mac parity claim.
interpretation.next_small_proposal: Screen this smaller mode-correct selective pipeline through the actual uv release frontend before considering any custom Node TAR writer.
